u.condition_text: Qualification 1: Registered applicants whose independently verified annual report includes every required attachment, whose signature is witnessed by an authorized officer, whose renewal remains pending during the announced review period, and whose nominated representative retains written authority for this application, with each separately identified annex retained in its original language and supplied with the approved explanatory statement, subject to continuing compliance with the published accessibility arrangements and prior written confirmation of the review location, except applicants whose license was suspended after notice unless the review panel has issued a written stay preserving eligibility.
